Peter, Tired, old Tony Evers is out campaigning with Barack Obama today at one of the country’s worst performing schools. And they think that’s something worth celebrating! Generations of kids have been failed by Tony Evers and our school system. Tony Evers clings to the status quo, and children are being left behind.
At the very school Obama and Evers are visiting today:
* Only 45% of kids graduate on time – compared to 90% of students statewide.
* Zero percent of kids can do math or science at grade level.

Simply put, Tony Evers is failing these kids. His inaction has taken away their future. Their opportunity. Instead of holding a celebration, he should be apologizing to these families.

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: Thank you for your prayers and warm wishes
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friend,

Sadly, a violent man broke into our family home yesterday morning, demanded to confront me and brutally attacked my husband Paul. Our children, our grandchildren and I are heartbroken and traumatized by the life-threatening attack on our Pop. We are grateful for the quick response of law enforcement and emergency services and for the life-saving medical care he is receiving.

Please know that your prayers and warm wishes are a comfort to our family and helping Paul make progress with his recovery. His condition continues to improve.

We are also comforted by these words from the Book of Isaiah: “Do not fear, for I am with you. Do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you. I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.”

We thank you for your prayers and warm wishes as well as the work you do to strengthen our Democracy.

Sincerely,
NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

name: Raphael Warnock
subject: re: President Obama and me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH |
body:
President Obama and I stepped off the rally stage yesterday here in Georgia.
| | |
---
Friend, **President Obama and I stepped off the rally stage yesterday here in Georgia.** I’m so proud to have him on our side.

If you didn’t get a chance to watch, here’s what we want you to know: **Come Nov. 8, we’re going to win this race and keep Georgia blue. **

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 11 years in prison for standing for life
body:
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Peter, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61761093:68HdvQG8N:m:1:3371812801:C823C19C08D9AF0DDE50B36F9D62AE4B:r) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61761093:68HdvQG8N:m:1:3371812801:C823C19C08D9AF0DDE50B36F9D62AE4B:r) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61761093:68HdvQG8N:m:1:3371812801:C823C19C08D9AF0DDE50B36F9D62AE4B:r) ** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone._** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. [**Please don't delay in donating to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND immediately.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61761093:68HdvQG8N:m:1:3371812801:C823C19C08D9AF0DDE50B36F9D62AE4B:r)
I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you,
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61761093:68HdvQG8N:m:1:3371812801:C823C19C08D9AF0DDE50B36F9D62AE4B:r)
---
Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel
---
P.S. Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood want to destroy pro-life, father-of-seven Mark Houck and intimidate people of faith everywhere. They'd love to see Mark rotting away in federal prison for his selfless devotion to the unborn, using his defense of his young son as the excuse. You and I cannot let that happen. Peter,

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I'm being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

I don't want to sound like an alarmist, but yesterday's fundraising totals shocked me to the core. subject: 11 years in prison for standing for life
body:
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Peter, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760205:Jy8evQGbN:m:1:3331703221:1DEEA1A6DB38145FE901384BC3F0F9BE:r) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760205:Jy8evQGbN:m:1:3331703221:1DEEA1A6DB38145FE901384BC3F0F9BE:r) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760205:Jy8evQGbN:m:1:3331703221:1DEEA1A6DB38145FE901384BC3F0F9BE:r) ** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone._** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. [**Please don't delay in donating to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND immediately.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760205:Jy8evQGbN:m:1:3331703221:1DEEA1A6DB38145FE901384BC3F0F9BE:r)
I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you,
---
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760205:Jy8evQGbN:m:1:3331703221:1DEEA1A6DB38145FE901384BC3F0F9BE:r)
---
Tom Brejcha
President & Chief Counsel
---

They'd love to see Mark rotting away in federal prison for his selfless devotion to the unborn, using his defense of his young son as the excuse. You and I cannot let that happen. the most important message you will read today
the most important message you will read today

| | | Friend,

Hi, I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0t6g0p8thm8hvlr2q91bhbi90ei2otclq1hvie0_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh62o31cph2bs "Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5av596rmn0e53tmbooc6d9oms8b16mpb682qu8g_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh62o31cph2bs "Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztt45li814e2m6nl9608rb66nm00aa06h7vesh3g_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh62o31cph2bs "A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.")**

name: Herschel Walker
subject: Racial slurs from my opposition
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
---

Peter,

I knew when I decided to run for office that my campaign would be met with support from a whole lot of folks, and I've been honored to see that support at hundreds of campaign stops across Georgia.

**But there are also racist bigots who want to demean me for the color of my skin and tear me apart because of my conservative viewpoints.**

I was attacked with racial slurs at a campaign event because I don't fit the Left's idea of what it means to be Black and conservative in America.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760294:J6kWKQGNc:m:1:3317145305:A80C10BA839FC9A8C611C8CF13DA5633:r)
While I was holding a press conference in front of an apartment building owned by Raphael Warnock's church - which has attempted to evict residents for late rent payments **(sometimes for as little as $28)** , a protester in the crowd said of me:

| _**" He's a joke. He tap dances, and he's a house n*****."**_
---

The reporters who were covering our event said _**nothing**_.

The local reporters who were covering our event questioned **no one** , despite urgent pleas from my campaign staff to do so. Unfortunately, this doesn't surprise me because that's the mainstream media for you. If Fox News had not reported it, the protester would've gotten away with it in plain sight.

Peter, it's sad this is the type of environment we're running in, but it's a pattern from the Left we've seen numerous times throughout this campaign. With early voting already underway, **[we need to ensure Georgians that we're not fazed by the nasty attacks against us.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760294:J6kWKQGNc:m:1:3317145305:A80C10BA839FC9A8C611C8CF13DA5633:r)**

**[Will you stand with me today to make it clear to the Left that we will not stand for this divisive, hateful language?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760294:J6kWKQGNc:m:1:3317145305:A80C10BA839FC9A8C611C8CF13DA5633:r)**

[** Stand With Herschel -> **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760294:J6kWKQGNc:m:1:3317145305:A80C10BA839FC9A8C611C8CF13DA5633:r)
Tuesday's protester viciously attacked me for the color of my skin because I'm willing to STAND UP for my conservative values and SPEAK OUT for the truth.

Georgia needs a new U.S. Senator, and **[I hope you'll support our campaign today to make it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760294:J6kWKQGNc:m:1:3317145305:A80C10BA839FC9A8C611C8CF13DA5633:r)**

Thank you,

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760294:J6kWKQGNc:m:1:3317145305:A80C10BA839FC9A8C611C8CF13DA5633:r)

Herschel Walker

Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn’t attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete’s sake.)

Zach didn’t break anything, or even hurt anyone’s feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he’s a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden’s Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What’s more, he hasn’t had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**
**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach’s disability payments because he’d been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged – not convicted!
**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

**Patriot, that’s why I’ve filed two critically important class action lawsuits on behalf of each and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent email.
**
If the Biden Justice Department and its FBI can push around and seek to destroy a peaceful, disabled Marine veteran for exercising his right to free speech, they can push you and me, our families, friends, and fellow Americans around, too.

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

Zach warns about that in a letter to his wife:

** “They are jailing innocent people on bogus and trumped-up charges because those people simply supported the sitting president Donald Trump at the time; which is absolutely insane. If you think it can’t happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you.”
**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zq4kcjqf1l3phmbovdg4ofpqgh53ju981ncac6io_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh6ao74cjh2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zonl9ielhovepn9ibsl9lmcs61jq8jgmm2fqq2rg_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh6ao74cjh2bs)

subject: Have you seen what they're doing to our kids?
body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758878:JeABKQGMN:m:1:3374012347:C904784DCF9317E29CFA290BDCB7893A:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758878:JeABKQGMN:m:1:3374012347:C904784DCF9317E29CFA290BDCB7893A:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758878:JeABKQGMN:m:1:3374012347:C904784DCF9317E29CFA290BDCB7893A:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758878:JeABKQGMN:m:1:3374012347:C904784DCF9317E29CFA290BDCB7893A:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

# 10 Days Left. It's go time.
Friends, there's no easy way to say it. Every polling place has a Democrat handing out their slate card. Not so for Republicans. There is a [Sign Up Genius to help organize volunteers](mailto:https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10c0e49acae2da1fbc25-early4?subject=Yes%2C%20I'll%20be%20a%20poll%20greeter...). If everyone on this email chain would take shift, we'd have more than enough coverage. You can make a difference. Take a shift at the polls. Make phone calls. Knock doors. Have you already voted? Good! Call home-bound friends and take them to the polls. Volunteer at Castelli or Republican HQ to answer phones. Make GOTV calls to voters who have yet to vote (we can help you do this from home). But, you have to do more than just vote. "Of, by and for the people," means us. Let's do this. _Tina Forsberg_

body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWhP8y5hKN

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit
about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in
Washington.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWhP8y5hKN

Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit
about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in
Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my
family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also
studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping
others in need.

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to
serve our country in the United States Army while I started my
nursing career.

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever,
Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing
him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his
eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to
be by Scotty's side.

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was
informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in
uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on
the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the
Army.

I refused.

Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty
Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the
way.

It's not every day you hear about American women going up
against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big
way-and won.

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right
thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue
being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never
be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an
incredible father and hero to our boys.

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for
US Senate to help families across the country achieve the
American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty
Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown
throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better
life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a
voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the
partisan gridlock in Congress.

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we
look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the
United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning
this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. So
please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the
momentum we've achieved so far.

KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT

STAND UP FOR AMERICA

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's
Tiffany Smiley.

The
Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the
COUNTRY!

Needless
to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the
November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our
state.

We are in
an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you.
Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader
with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American
Dream is not lost.

Rush
support now to be a part of history.

Let's
raise money and WIN,

Tiffany
Smiley

JOIN TEAM SMILEY

Team
Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know
we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key
deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether
or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the
Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany
is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year
incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things
around TODAY.

There's
no time to wait on the sidelines.

That's
why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!

This is
our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for
Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S.
Senate, plain and simple.

Our team
doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today,
so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help
increase our momentum!

Tiffany
is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh
leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be
your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out
of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this
moment. Step up now!

reveal a message from Tiffany Smiley.

subject: The outcome of this race will ultimately be determined by people like you who decided to be a part of this campaign. Since I'm rejecting all corporate PAC money, any amount you can give will make a big difference.
body:
Not much longer to get the message out
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of mega-donors lining up to write big checks to this campaign. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class. Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker. Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson. It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority. I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together. **[With $31 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win in November.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb4b4bed3-852d-460b-b10e-f75cf0555dca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** So I’m asking:

---
| **[Can you please make a $25 contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate today? Since I'm rejecting all corporate PAC money, any amount you can give will make a big difference.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T02d056e0-fe71-4c8d-8724-5644d387e8d1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** The outcome of this race will ultimately be determined by people like you who decided to be a part of this campaign. Thank you for chipping in today, if you can afford it. All my best, Mandela

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. body:
|
| | | Peter,

Hi, I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760237:6YVDHQGKN:m:1:3331421248:91B7562F0C7761C38F4CBB411B301665:r "Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne
Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760237:6YVDHQGKN:m:1:3331421248:91B7562F0C7761C38F4CBB411B301665:r "Can you chip in
$10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760237:6YVDHQGKN:m:1:3331421248:91B7562F0C7761C38F4CBB411B301665:r "A donation of $10,

Tulsi Gabbard

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn’t attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete’s sake.)

Zach didn’t break anything, or even hurt anyone’s feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he’s a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden’s Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What’s more, he hasn’t had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**
**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach’s disability payments because he’d been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged – not convicted!
**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

**Patriot, that’s why I’ve filed two critically important class action lawsuits on behalf of each and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent email.

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zugo1jdd6qvi9928fqt61ihe7dhqt2r0imrg0f5o_rp22sh2s8i66or7chj6co36cph2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zej7bt89uebiqc5vuptv9gfctluia8573qvf9dc0_rp22sh2s8i66or7chj6co36cph2bs)

name: Ret. Col. Doug Mastriano
subject: You’re not allowed to talk about this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Doug Mastriano
body:
---
| | | | | | | | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758990:JmT9hQGNw:m:1:3374012347:9EFE3E7860EEE8D6E4180DE45C6B9FD4:r)
---
| Peter,
I recently joined Tucker Carlson and the buzz around my campaign has continued to gain tremendous momentum. I'm taking time from my busy schedule campaigning to write you this email, so even if you don't send a gift, I'd really appreciate it if you'd read it in its entirety.
**[If you'd like to make a donation to continue my campaign's momentum, you can do so here.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758990:JmT9hQGNw:m:1:3374012347:9EFE3E7860EEE8D6E4180DE45C6B9FD4:r)**
We covered a number of topics that I think every voter in PA should know about.
**The Establishment turning their back on a 30 year Army veteran.** I served our country honorably and led some of the best young men our nation has to offer, yet when I announced for Governor the political Establishment on both sides shunned me... it must mean I'm speaking the hard truths, but as our second President John Adams famously said "facts are stubborn things." The political Establishment in our country is failing Republicans, Democrats, and everyone in between, and I'll never bow to their go-along get-along agenda. They doubted me in the primary, but with the backing of the grassroots and patriots in Pennsylvania and across our country, I proved them wrong, and I'm going to do it again on November 8th.
**Unleashing Pennsylvania 's oil and gas reserves to jumpstart our economy on Day 1 of a Mastriano administration.** The answer to many of our economic woes is unleashing American energy dominance, and as Governor of Pennsylvania, on Day 1, I'll have the power to open up drilling and fracking at a scale never seen before in our nation's history. Joe Biden's war on American energy got us into this mess, and Pennsylvania will be where the American energy comeback begins. | | | | [DONATE](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758990:JmT9hQGNw:m:1:3374012347:9EFE3E7860EEE8D6E4180DE45C6B9FD4:r)
---
**Josh Shapiro 's record of failure when it comes to violent crime.**
Unlike Josh Shapiro, I've served in war zones, and right now Philadelphia looks more like a war zone than the city where American Democracy was born. Crime has gone up 40% since Shapiro took power as Attorney General. Videos have surfaced online showing bands of criminals with illegal automatic weapons hopping out of vans at gas stations in Philadelphia and stealing cars of innocent citizens. There's one place criminals like that will be under a Mastriano Administration, the state penitentiary, where they will be serving maximum sentences.

**There are 12 Pennsylvanian 's dying everyday from Fentynal.**
Biden's open border has drugs flowing into our country freely and it's causing a drug epidemic in Pennsylvania. Dealers and traffickers of these lethal drugs will be in the same place as the criminals sticking up drivers at gunpoint, the penitentiary.

I could have ridden off into the sunset for a comfortable retirement with the love of my life, my wife Rebbie, but instead I'm here, fighting for you and your family. **[I'd be proud to call you a donor to my campaign if you're in a position to give.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61758990:JmT9hQGNw:m:1:3374012347:9EFE3E7860EEE8D6E4180DE45C6B9FD4:r)**

name: American Action News
subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history.
This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd1484g67obpjp41dc6rvhqql6dovmg09fcvrlto_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh69ob1cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqf27lhde8kg34tiumgt8fho788e329983o1rf38_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh69ob1cph2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3hipt1b46ms2idu24ljbld03vltums935dg60eo_rp22sh2s8i66or7chh69ob1cph2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

**

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents - AND WIN!

Larry Klayman

They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as "the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written." That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I 'd like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, "_The Federalist Papers_ ,"on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**" The Federalist Papers"**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 11 years in prison for standing for life
body:
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Peter, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61761134:J_2XiQGNQ:m:1:3372576248:489C63210F4C88C0D6083C04D9315CE4:r) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. body:
And we're defending him in court!

| | | Peter, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760764:JseNWQGNU:m:1:3360412034:57D6980691F9A06065D2116CD51A8DD9:r) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760764:JseNWQGNU:m:1:3360412034:57D6980691F9A06065D2116CD51A8DD9:r) Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. **[Can I count on your gift of $40, $60, $100, or more to stand with Mark Houck today and fight back against the dark forces of Planned Parenthood?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760764:JseNWQGNU:m:1:3360412034:57D6980691F9A06065D2116CD51A8DD9:r) ** I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone._** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. [**Please don't delay in donating to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND immediately.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760764:JseNWQGNU:m:1:3360412034:57D6980691F9A06065D2116CD51A8DD9:r)
I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you,

Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act... and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family. We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. Make no mistake, friend, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone. Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you, Tom Brejcha President & Chief Counsel P.S. Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood want to destroy pro-life, father-of-seven Mark Houck and intimidate people of faith everywhere. They'd love to see Mark rotting away in federal prison for his selfless devotion to the unborn, using his defense of his young son as the excuse. body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61759995:J3x7cQGNS:m:1:3346849603:2D796183B0480E9CA77A19A8074DE316:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61759995:J3x7cQGNS:m:1:3346849603:2D796183B0480E9CA77A19A8074DE316:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents andthe community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61759995:J3x7cQGNS:m:1:3346849603:2D796183B0480E9CA77A19A8074DE316:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61759995:J3x7cQGNS:m:1:3346849603:2D796183B0480E9CA77A19A8074DE316:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Katherine Fischer

So believe me when I say, I wouldn't be asking for your help if it wasn’t urgent.
Fixing our broken immigration system, building new water infrastructure, and working together to solve inflation: all of these issues are on the ballot this November. name: Connor Boyack
subject: Debunking 40 popular political and economic myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true. It’s a narrative that you’ll often see

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zactsib88434anm59u3njtc9jmfhl29evsosvnco_rp22sh2s8i66or7chgm4o34sph2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ze86nivn7j1qfav9c5ar29qr82ljrob5moqvqjj8_rp22sh2s8i66or7chgm4o34sph2bs)**
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgs8515mvbmu6lvmc67hnph3qeq6acr3dfjpia2g_rp22sh2s8i66or7chgm4o34sph2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zklq9etqbb0ns2lk9hlrab1p47jp0u94te45t7c0_rp22sh2s8i66or7chgm4o34sph2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zjpfdlfchel2f6ujouupk2o6bp2k5pnencbhera8_rp22sh2s8i66or7chgm4o34sph2bs)**_ today!
Thank you,

Connor Boyack
Author, Tuttle Twins
Founder, Libertas Institute

Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn’t attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete’s sake.)

Zach didn’t break anything, or even hurt anyone’s feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he’s a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden’s Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What’s more, he hasn’t had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**
**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach’s disability payments because he’d been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged – not convicted!
**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

** “They are jailing innocent people on bogus and trumped-up charges because those people simply supported the sitting president Donald Trump at the time; which is absolutely insane. If you think it can’t happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you.”
**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjjaann3e71hm664g93u99d3ih7co47jip5b92i0_rp22sh2s8i66or7chgm4o34c1h2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!
