subject: Isaiah 41:10 says...
body:
| | | [](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=09fae095d7&e=fdefed58de)
---
Peter:Ephesians 6:12 tells us: _"For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms."_ My friends, when St. Paul wrote this he was facing vastly different times than we are now, yet his words still resonate with us today because this is where Biden the Usurper has placed us; deep in a struggle to keep America safe from tyranny.Our struggle as Conservatives is not against anything heavenly, but is instead against the destruction of the American way of life we all love and that the Good Lord Above has created for us.Our struggle is against the authorities who we call “THE DEMOCRATS” but who in reality are a global cabal assembled to turn this nation into a socialist nightmare state bereft of the freedoms granted us by The Constitution and The Bill of Rights.My name is **Irene Armendariz-Jackson** and I am a successful **Latina** (not “Latinx” because “EX” means “mistake”) who is living the American Dream every day. I’m the proud daughter of LEGAL immigrants, and a loving parent fighting to keep America safe for my children.I am also a “border wife” who sees first-hand the devastation of Biden’s still-unexplained opening of the southern border. The sex trafficking, the gun-running, the rape of women and children — these are not just Fox News headlines to me. My husband sees this every day as a Border Patrol agent and his stories really make my blood boil. For this reason I’m running for Congress to help make America stay the same wonderful SAFE country my family LEGALLY immigrated too.Right now we are facing daily illegal border crossings of UNKNOWN illegal aliens from every country on earth! This has gone on almost since day one of the Biden Administration and, as far as I can tell, no one has ever been given a common sense answer for it OR EVEN ASKED WHY? And all during an alleged PANDEMIC that no one in the Democrat party seems to be scared about.**So who does this benefit?** Certainly not the American taxpayer whose money will go to housing, healthcare and education for these illegals.Certainly not the parents of children who will face increased crime and violence in the streets.Certainly not the American worker whose job opportunities will be substantially lessened by cheap illegal labor.No, simply put, Joe Biden’s plan is **EVERYTHING BAD FOR AMERICANS!**
| [DEFEAT THE BIDEN ENABLERS IN CONGRESS!](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=ee17865ab8&e=fdefed58de)
---
So Isaiah 41:10 teaches us:_"So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand."_ As a Christian my heart goes out to anyone forced to flee their homeland for sanctuary, and America is the place to come to IF YOU DO SO LEGALLY. But what the Biden Administration is doing must shock the conscience AND THE SOUL of every America-loving patriot, Christian or otherwise. God will indeed strengthen us and help us defeat this scourge, just as he helped _Moses defeat Pharaoh_ , but we have to help Him out by doing our part as America First Conservatives.
And so I’m asking for your help and support in my battle to RESTORE AMERICA! We have an election in just TEN SHORT DAYS and we need EVERY bit of help making sure that we WIN this race and defeat Veronica Escobar and her open borders agenda!**Will you stand with me today and help us restore the safety and security of our nation?**

| The election is almost one week away, and I need your support, Peter.

But before I ask for your help, you deserve to know why I’m running for Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin.

**I was born and raised in Wisconsin and believe everyone deserves the opportunity to earn a good living, send their kids to good schools, and have access to quality, affordable healthcare.**

Wisconsinites want to live in a safe community. We want to respect basic human and civil rights. And we want the planet to be here for our grandchildren and beyond.

I will be an advocate for all Wisconsinites, focused on making a difference in people's daily lives and putting our state first.

**I have the experience, passion, and skills to lead. That is why I’m running for Lieutenant Governor, and my agenda is simple:**
* Make sure the economy works for everyone, with jobs that provide a living wage, and encourage and support entrepreneurs.

* Protect our shared values, keep our community safe, and ensure every school is a great school.

* Make sure everyone has access to the world’s best healthcare here in America.

* Honor our democracy and those who fought for equality by uniting around our American values of dignity, respect, and opportunity.

I am not a career politician. I am a nurse and a businessperson, and I believe we can do better. Together, we can keep moving Wisconsin forward, but I need your help. It's time to Take Back NY. Every vote matters. With everyone pitching in, we will WIN come election day!
-Rob

Today's press conference by Governor Hochul and Attorney General Letitia James announcing additional resources to address the state's rampant crime wave is an Election Day "Hail Mary." These resources and more should already be in place. These statements also display a total failure of leadership and are insulting to millions of New Yorkers who fear for their safety. Dismissing news stories about violence against innocent people as being the product of "human emotion" and suggesting there is a difference between "real facts" and "people's fears" is more evidence that they don't take the issue seriously.

body:
I’m out in the district today, wrapping up some final campaign stops for the day, and wondering when I’ll get a response from Tony Gonzales about a debate in this race.

In case you missed it, I sent a certified letter to Tony a few weeks ago challenging him to a debate — and I haven’t received a response yet.

To be clear, I believe the people of TX-23 deserve to hear us debate about the issues that matter most. We should be debating the future of the energy industry here in Texas, and our plans for TX-23: rural development, immigration reform, border security, and gun safety.

But Tony is choosing to stay silent. And the truth is, his plans for TX-23 are supported by his big-money backers, not the families of this district.

Tony knows that if he debates me — I will prove him to be the fraudulent leader that he is. So here’s how you can help: Make a donation now to help us dial up the public pressure on Tony to take part in a debate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-lira?refcode=EM_FR_221020Debate_EOM_TL_FL_10_NG_N_logo&amount=10&recurring=]

Tony’s voting record shows that he is only concerned with party politics. I believe we deserve a representative that is concerned about what’s best for the district.

I’m ready. And I’m fighting as hard as I can to unseat Tony in November. I’ve been traveling across the district meeting with voters, and the people WANT to see a debate between us.

The bills we’ve passed will help New Jersey families thrive, not just survive. **We passed the Inflation Reduction Act,** which will lower prescription drug prices, reduce health insurance costs for millions, and help homeowners save around $1,000 a year on energy costs. **We passed the CHIPS and Science Act** to invest billions in R&D; and workforce development, create good paying jobs, focus on small businesses, and support union growth. **We passed a $1 billion infrastructure bill.** This massive bill will fund long overdue improvements to our busy highways, New Jersey Transit, and install electric vehicle charging stations. It will modernize American infrastructure. **We passed multiple supply chain bills,** easing access to baby formula, manufacturing equipment, and other supplies critical to our economy and communities. **We passed the first new gun control law in 30 years.** It will impose tougher checks on young gun buyers, and encourage states to remove guns from those considered a threat to public safety. **We passed several mental health bills,** like my police training law focused on PTSD and TBI. And our committee passed my legislation that expands Medicare to cover mental health services. Everyone should have unfettered access to the resources they need to address mental illness and addiction, and Democrats are proud to do our part. name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=bc81f9a2666244c08d62fb4d35a1886b&_e=SW5VcryNt_UWtoZoqWH8XBZOtAEwUFxIAg1emGGBVTwji9vuqqL2zXiD1q_r4wVgIiKnXInH5MggT3s3kSukg1ECX6n4ejdD7lWmkufb4UsA0mORW0E30UCs1VjyJ2Z4qB-QAvVXe-NFGLxQpYTZSr3K2UJCCFHNXpSXH5wTM0jJbANcBqPDSnTss0LU3pwJY34W6TysvFMPjwEzyYsHRqOsYP6kebyqicUnNwEu1Ypmp00uNJeiLWhQtyHqYrRS27nvgobL0hjKGwY9v03jM7sc_uR7W_sB3Usmqljeq0B4Ksg1VWe2JRHshCbG2XmGREf138b3RrXCzeDLLFB7jUmntVJl6KKx0AmJZu_Xo5cMbSklvKMi1UhBkzNS7EWmfOurzkKjLlO2jlSgFCDJpQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=bc81f9a2666244c08d62fb4d35a1886b&_e=SW5VcryNt_UWtoZoqWH8XBZOtAEwUFxIAg1emGGBVTwji9vuqqL2zXiD1q_r4wVgIiKnXInH5MggT3s3kSukg1ECX6n4ejdD7lWmkufb4UsA0mORW0E30UCs1VjyJ2Z4qB-QAvVXe-NFGLxQpYTZSr3K2UJCCFHNXpSXH5wTM0jJbANcBqPDSnTss0LU3pwJY34W6TysvFMPjwEzyYsHRqOsYP6kebyqicUnNwEu1YpbxS-DgzD3xJZxUNX400D09H2oMjKuMdV5ChCSR_-o3AOKGuDCus6Qyb9dHT43_K7g2yBSo_nD0gq-8lLKb6v2kwkDUiGYZ8boICIQNzCHUhJlmCl3IlOcdBuUgIPVLNgL9nH1eh2aEKPle5E2jiX-QbLnWwxyDO4bHVoPtOslcQ%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn’t attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete’s sake.)

Zach didn’t break anything, or even hurt anyone’s feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he’s a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden’s Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What’s more, he hasn’t had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**
**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach’s disability payments because he’d been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged – not convicted!
**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

**Patriot, that’s why I’ve filed two critically important class action lawsuits on behalf of each and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent email.
**
If the Biden Justice Department and its FBI can push around and seek to destroy a peaceful, disabled Marine veteran for exercising his right to free speech, they can push you and me, our families, friends, and fellow Americans around, too.

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

Zach warns about that in a letter to his wife:

** “They are jailing innocent people on bogus and trumped-up charges because those people simply supported the sitting president Donald Trump at the time; which is absolutely insane. If you think it can’t happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you.”
**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z050linfdbn8p0cksabdb3m1lbj33i3ntlbvu6r0_rp22sh2s8i66or7chim4o72c9h2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z66pb001b9oe37c3rj6qiissnn902661tg7ok4v0_rp22sh2s8i66or7chim4o72c9h2bs)

body:
We need leaders who know Missouri, who love Missouri, and who are truly committed to serving Missouri families.
Hi there, Peter. It's Trudy's campaign manager, Alex. I wanted to make sure you saw this message from Trudy because I think it's a really special one. **[(If you read her email already and haven't made a donation yet, it'd mean the world to us if you could chip in $5 now.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53655660/376126873/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk401-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWVhMTA2Mi03ZDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4CzBVYCimPJHWRBaoBJ6LYMqBkPTcu5BH_NuMirTC3c=)**
---
**When her email hit my inbox, I stopped working to read through the entire thing – and then I read it again.** You see, like Trudy, I was born and raised here. This state has given me so much in life – friends, community, a top-notch education, a supportive hometown, and, of course, real Missouri values.
That's why it has been painful to see the Show Me State gain national attention for all the ways that our leaders are failing families here: our staggering rates of opioid overdoses, our increasingly extreme abortion mandates, and our leaders undermining democracy at every turn.
We need leaders who know Missouri, who love Missouri, and who are truly committed to serving Missouri families. **Leaders like that don't come along often. But when they do, you have to throw everything you've got behind them.** That's why I put my life on hold to run this campaign full-time – even after I promised myself I would sit this election cycle out.
You see, I know that Trudy is the leader Missourians deserve – and I know that this is the year that we're finally going to flip this seat blue. **But we can only defeat Eric Schmitt and his megadonors if folks like you give this race everything you've got in these last 9 days before the election.[That's why I'm asking you, Peter, to not sit this one out. Please, will you make a donation to flip Missouri blue, send Trudy to the Senate, and give Missouri the compassionate, honest leadership we deserve?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53655661/376126877/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk401-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWVhMTA2Mi03ZDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4CzBVYCimPJHWRBaoBJ6LYMqBkPTcu5BH_NuMirTC3c=)**
Thank you for being on this team. Trudy and I are so grateful.

Onward to the election,

Alex Witt (Trudy's campaign manager)
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Trudy Busch Valentine**
Date: Sat, Oct 29, 2022
Subject: with my whole heart
| | |
---
Peter, for four generations my family has called Missouri our home. I was born here, I grew up here, I raised my kids here, and I served my community as a nurse and advocate here. **[Now, I'm about to ask you to make an investment in the future of this beautiful state. Can you give me a minute to explain why?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53655662/376126879/-1746441832?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk401-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWVhMTA2Mi03ZDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4CzBVYCimPJHWRBaoBJ6LYMqBkPTcu5BH_NuMirTC3c=)**
**After spending my entire life in this state, I can say this with my whole heart: I _love_ Missouri.**
The deep forests of the Ozarks in the south, the bountiful plains up north that stretch on endlessly and feed our families, the great Missouri River that runs through our state – Missouri is, without a doubt, absolutely beautiful. But the real reason I'll always call the Show Me State home is the vibrant, diverse communities who also call her home.
Whether in our great cities like St. Louis, Kansas City, and Jefferson City or the tight-knit rural towns like Chillicothe and St. James that dot our state, the people here are one of a kind.
Missourians are bold, fiercely independent, and deeply loyal (especially to our baseball teams). As our Show Me State nickname implies, we have a healthy level of skepticism, and we refuse to tolerate any nonsense. **But more than anything else, we will do anything to defend those we love.**
I love Missouri and the families within, and it's been the honor of a lifetime to serve them as a nurse, volunteer, and advocate. **But it breaks my heart to watch this state be sold out for a fat check from corporate lobbyists, to watch our values be tossed aside in favor of personal ambition, and to see our leaders choose partisanship over people.** We deserve so much better. That's why I'm running for Senate – to give families the leadership that embodies true Missouri values: integrity, independence, and compassion.
I promise you that I'm in this race for the right reasons, and you have my word that I'll deliver real change for your family in Washington. But I can't beat my MAGA opponent without your help. **[So please, Peter, with just days until the election, I'm personally asking: Will you invest in a better, brighter future, for Missouri and our whole country? I know that Missouri is ready to flip blue – but to win on Election Day, I am counting on your help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53655663/376126880/-1746441832?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk401-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWVhMTA2Mi03ZDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4CzBVYCimPJHWRBaoBJ6LYMqBkPTcu5BH_NuMirTC3c=)**

So if you believe we need a Congress that is willing to pass universal background checks, [**we’re asking you to contribute $3 to help us elect that Congress.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-oct22.6iboAv&refcode=em221030-1-15&t=1&akid=2685%2E3935704%2EAKBIoL)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I’m asking if you can contribute $3 to help send Mandela Barnes to the Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin
body:
I just left Wisconsin, and I know Mandela Barnes can defeat Ron Johnson – as long as we all roll up our sleeves and do the work.
#
Hi there -
I just left Wisconsin and I know Mandela Barnes can defeat Ron Johnson — as long as we all roll up our sleeves and do the work.
Mandela is trailing Ron Johnson by just one point in last week's CNN poll, and he's facing some very ugly attack ads from Republican super PACs. **We are so close to winning in Wisconsin, but it’s going to take serious resources to flip this Senate seat.**
Tomorrow Mandela faces the final end-of-month fundraising deadline before Election Day. He needs a lot of donations before midnight tonight to stay on track to reach his goals.
Unlike Ron Johnson, Mandela doesn't accept any corporate PAC money, so your donation will make a real difference.
[**Can you chip in $3 — or whatever makes sense — to Mandela Barnes’ campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin before his important end-of-month fundraising deadline? Together we can expand our Democratic majority and defeat Ron Johnson.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=1&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
_If you 've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Express Donate: $3](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1272?c0=mandela-em-oct22.R5mi9l&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=20&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
[Express Donate: $25](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1273?c0=mandela-em-oct22.EgXJNr&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=21&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
[Express Donate: $50](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1274?c0=mandela-em-oct22.9S-_mg&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=22&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
[Express Donate: $100](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1275?c0=mandela-em-oct22.vyE4YF&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=23&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
[Express Donate: $250](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1266?c0=mandela-em-oct22.TLNN8P&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=24&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
[Or donate another amount](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=25&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
Look, our 50/50 Senate majority isn't enough — we need to expand it. And Wisconsin is one of our best opportunities to do that.
Ron Johnson has been named the most vulnerable Republican Senator up for re-election this November, and it's not hard to see why.
Ron Johnson has used his time in office to benefit himself, his wealthy donors, and large corporations while working people are getting squeezed to their breaking point.
Ron Johnson celebrated the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, and he has co-sponsored eight natioanal abortion bans — including one with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother.
He even participated in a scheme to hand a list of fake electors to Mike Pence on January 6th to try to rig the election for Donald Trump. He sympathized with the insurrectionists and insisted that they were “peaceful” protestors. Enough is enough.
The good news is that this Wisconsin Senate seat is up for grabs in just 9 days. And Mandela Barnes urgently needs our support in order to beat Ron Johnson and expand our Senate majority.
Let's not forget that Joe Biden won Wisconsin by only 20,682 votes in 2020. That's a margin of victory of just 0.6%.
Wisconsin will be close again in 2022, which is why I need to ask you one more time:
[**Can you make a $3 contribution to Mandela Barnes today — ahead of his final end-of-month fundraising deadline of the campaign? He’s running a grassroots-funded campaign, so any amount you can give will make a real difference.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=26&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
When Mandela goes on to win in November, you can know that the contribution you made today helped make it possible.
Thanks for being a part of this.
Elizabeth Warren
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-oct22.Zk_Uo1&refcode=em221030-1-gm-full6&t=27&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. We'd hate to see you go, but if you'd like you can [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=28&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6). You can also [**sign up to receive fewer emails.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/fewer-emails/?source=em-footer&t=29&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
Mandela is counting on people like you to fund this campaign. [**Make a contribution to stand with Mandela today.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mandela-em-footer?refcode=em-footer&t=30&refcode2=3863_196590_rKdAZ6&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
Submit this form to [**update your contact information.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/update-contact-info/?source=em-footer&t=31&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6)
Be sure to [**visit our campaign store**](https://store.mandelabarnes.com/?t=32&akid=3863%2E196590%2ErKdAZ6) to check out all of the latest Mandela merchandise.
To receive important updates from our campaign, text JOIN to 99749 or [**if you're on a mobile device, follow this link to opt in to text updates.**](https://mandela.afy.ai/GaB1F)
[](https://mandela.afy.ai/GaB1F)
By providing your cell phone number you consent to receive recurring text message updates from Mandela Barnes for Wisconsin, including by automated text message. Text HELP for help, STOP to end. Message and data rates may apply. [Privacy Policy](https://mandelabarnes.com/privacy-policy) and [Terms of Service](https://mandelabarnes.com/terms-of-service).

P.O. Box 597
Milwaukee, WI 53201

unconscionable that it has zero exception for rape or incest.

From day one, I promised you and all of North Carolina that we would work hard every single day to win this race.
#

From day one, I promised you and all of North Carolina that we would work hard every single day to win this race. With just a week to go and less than 48 hours until our October fundraising deadline, we must give this our all.
We cannot wake up on November 9 with any regrets. We need to know we did everything we could, made the best decisions possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested.
If you’re wondering why I feel so strongly about this, it is because in 2020 my race for Chief Justice came down to 401 votes — a margin of .007%.
Yes, that’s how close statewide races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done.
And with polls consistently showing this race in a dead heat, there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin in November.
So when the challenges feel steep, I remind myself of those 401 votes. And I remember my promise to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we turn North Carolina blue.
It means the world to me that so many people have pitched in their time and talent already. But it’s going to take all of us, so I’m asking:

body:

---
Hey Peter — we have just **THREE DAYS left before our last end-of-month deadline** and tons of work still to be done.

In Colorado, mail-in ballots are out. That means that**people are voting on whether or not to keep me in this seat right now, today.**

We’re in the home stretch & that’s why****[**I need your help now**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=169dc3954e&e=fdefed58de)**** more than ever.

My radical liberal opponent is spending MILLIONS**on TV ads**. That amount of money can **FLIP THIS DISTRICT** from red to blue.

[**We can’t let that happen.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=8beb518709&e=fdefed58de)

Our campaign **urgently need your help** to get our message out to the voters of this district for the next 5 days.

[**Let’s keep our district in the Republican column—chip in anything you can RIGHT now so we can stop Nancy Pelosi from gaining another seat in the House.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=a0475013bd&e=fdefed58de)
[](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=479570d93d&e=fdefed58de)
Since my district elected me to Congress, **I’ve stood up for our freedoms** time and time again, as **one of the strongest voices against** the Biden-Pelosi radical agenda.

Make no mistake – you will get the **exact opposite** of that if my Dem opponent wins.

Let's keep this district safe from a Nancy Pelosi rubber stamp. [**Pitch in anything you can to our campaign today.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d82fe85c38&e=fdefed58de) For Freedom,

**Millions. **
That's how much DeSantis’s far-right mega donors are pumping into his campaign to make sure we don’t beat him on Election Day.
**$3.**
That's the contribution we're asking you to make today to help Charlie Crist beat Ron DeSantis and restore decency to Tallahassee.
We know $3 doesn't seem like the kind of money that can take on the millions of dollars being spent against us or the extremist billionaires who are funding our opponent.
But we're here to tell you it is — because it's not just your $3.
By the time you’ve donated $3, Judith, a teacher in Fort Myers, FL will have donated $15.

While Betsy’s opponents are flying in political celebrities from the East Coast, Betsy spent this week traveling on her All Of Oregon Fly In, stopping in 10 cities and 10 counties in 48 hours to meet with Oregonians where they live and work. Hi there,

On May 24th, 2022, we lost our beautiful 9 year old daughter to senseless gun violence.

Jacklyn was a free spirit that was always willing and wanting to help others. Her favorite color was sage green, she loved to sing, make videos on TikTok and interact with her friends on Snapchat.

**Jacklyn was one of the 21 victims of the Uvalde school shooting.** And while we know there’s nothing we can do to bring our daughter back, we couldn’t stand idly by during one of the most important elections of our lifetime.

That’s why we’re writing to you now. John is the candidate we’re supporting because he’s not afraid to stand up to the NRA, and he’s promised to take action to stop the gun violence epidemic.

After Uvalde, it was clear that we can no longer wait to take action. We must elect candidates who will make sure this doesn’t happen again– if we don’t, we’re not just failing Jacklyn or all the lives lost that day, but all Americans.

Friend,

I am writing today to humbly ask if you can split a $25 contribution between my campaign and Seth Moulton to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and expand the Democratic majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221030]
Let me be clear:
Flipping Wisconsin's Senate seat this November is not a given. It's going to take an incredible amount of work to make it possible.
You can count on me to work as hard as possible to defeat Ron Johnson. But I cannot win this race alone.
I need you. A Marquette poll came out that shows me trailing by 1 point. Without you, we could lose.
So far more than 200,000 people have donated to this campaign. It means the world to me. But right now, I need you. And it’s not just me who needs you. All the people who have already donated, they need you, too. Because the only way we'll win is if we're in this together.
I am humbly asking if you can add your $25 contribution, split with Seth Moulton, before our fundraising drive ends at midnight tonight. I'm counting on people like you to help flip Wisconsin's Senate seat and expand the Democratic majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-barnes?refcode=221030]
Thank you in advance for chipping in. Running for office, and especially a Senate seat against a Republican incumbent isn’t easy. But the stakes make the challenge well worth it, especially when we’re in it together.
Mandela

subject: We won't give up.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH |
body:
It’s Mandy and Kathryn, and we’re here to give you a reason to be hopeful as we head into the final weeks of New Hampshire’s critical battle ground race for U.S. Senate.
| | |
---
Hi there, friend! It’s Mandy and Kathryn, and we’re here to give you a reason to be hopeful as we head into the final week of New Hampshire’s critical battleground race for U.S. Senate.
**It’s you!**
Just by reading this email – **[and of course by giving $3, or whatever you can](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53650269/376108394/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1968-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDQ3ZjExOS03MDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4EfmHgIbA6FhDz4-i3jS9frUB0BSpvmAvfQ4uOjYtrY=)** – you are helping to support Maggie Hassan’s campaign.
It is truly inspiring to see droves of our fellow citizens speaking out, getting involved, and giving to candidates that they believe in. And beyond just being inspirational to folks like us, who have been engaging in this work for a long time, it has a genuine impact on our country.
**[And your voice (and your gift) has never been more important, because Maggie is facing a tough race against a radical right-wing opponent.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53650270/376108419/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1968-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDQ3ZjExOS03MDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4EfmHgIbA6FhDz4-i3jS9frUB0BSpvmAvfQ4uOjYtrY=)**
When Maggie’s opponent, Don Bolduc, was asked about the threat of a nationwide abortion ban, do you know what his response was? **Telling women to “get over it.”**
Well, you know what, folks, we won’t “**get over it**.” We refuse to let Don Bolduc sweep his dangerous, radical, anti-choice agenda under the rug, but we also refuse to give in to despair.
Yes, the prospect of Don Bolduc as a U.S. Senator is terrifying, but the truth is we are more hopeful than ever. That’s thanks, in no small part, to the outpouring of support from people like you, for champions like Maggie Hassan.
We’ve followed Maggie and have always admired her ferocious work on the behalf of women and all Americans. And now she needs people like us, everyone, to help her defeat Don Bolduc and continue that important work.
**[Giving a gift of even just $3 or $10 has a real impact in a race as close as Maggie’s, so if you have been looking for a way to get involved, this is it.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53650271/376108423/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1968-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDQ3ZjExOS03MDU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4EfmHgIbA6FhDz4-i3jS9frUB0BSpvmAvfQ4uOjYtrY=)**
You don’t have to “get over it” – in fact, you shouldn’t, but you don’t have to give in either. **You can act!**
So please, join us in turning rage into hope.
Your voice matters,
– Mandy Patinkin & Kathryn Grody
| | _Kathryn Grody and Mandy Patinkin are actors and activists who have been married for almost 42 years. Patinkin is most known for his roles in_ Homeland _and_ The Princess Bride _. Grody wrote and acted in an autobiographical play called_ Mom's Life _. During the 2020 election, Grody and Patinkin gathered a large social media following for their viral videos encouraging people to vote._

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — [**if you agree, will you split a $20 donation between my campaign and Tom O’Halleran?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53650871/376110151/1586170691?amount=20&refcode=em_fr_2022.10.30_b1_mk_all-nd&refcode2=28b5f50b-7258-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOGI1ZjUwYi03MjU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2stzuq-NTi51_DkFDgxVeo_C4tvlI7ghLazZ1Kp24Q4=)

No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions. And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble. National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. But I refuse to let them win. I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — = I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.
**
Zach didn't attack the U.S. Capitol Police. (His own father and grandfather were Philadelphia cops, like my brother, for Pete's sake.)

Zach didn't break anything, or even hurt anyone's feelings with harsh words.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.
**
But because he's a member of the Proud Boys, Joe Biden's Department of Justice has charged him with seditious conspiracy.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

**What 's more, he hasn't had the chance to hold his baby girl even once.
**
**And to add insult to injury, the VA notified his wife, Amanda, that they were cutting off Zach 's disability payments because he'd been charged with seditious conspiracy. Just charged - not convicted!
**
As you can imagine, all of this has been brutally hard on Zach, his wife, and two daughters. No freedom...no rights...no due process...IN AMERICA!

**Patriot, that 's why I've filed two critically important class action lawsuits on behalf of each and every January 6 Peaceful Protester who are getting brutally abused by the justice system as I write you this urgent email.

You and I, and the people we love in are in grave danger.

**
That's why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 45 years.

body:
Pennsylvania is a battleground state — that shouldn’t be breaking news to many people. It’s also no secret that the last several elections have been unbelievably close.

Hey, Derek. Pennsylvania is a battleground state — that shouldn’t be breaking news to many people. It’s also no secret that the last several elections have been _unbelievably_ close. But, what most people forget is that these elections come down to just a few thousand votes. In 2020 it came down to 80,000 votes, in 2016 it came down to fewer than 40,000. **That's less than 1% of the vote.** **[This race is going to be just as close if not closer, and the stakes have never been higher. Derek, winning is our only option in this race. With just a day left until our end-of-month fundraising deadline, will you donate any amount to our campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53695314/376160642/-586780698?refcode=email_103022_eomclose_allactives&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=d66da472-9c58-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjZkYTQ3Mi05YzU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m37BbQjX3OSGOzqBfYYdbhHPG-EIQpRSjsFGDKcOG1U=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53695317/376160646/-2146338512?refcode=email_103022_eomclose_allactives&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&express_lane=true&refcode2=d66da472-9c58-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjZkYTQ3Mi05YzU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m37BbQjX3OSGOzqBfYYdbhHPG-EIQpRSjsFGDKcOG1U=)

Between Pennsylvania’s history as a battleground swing state and the tendency for midterm elections to have lower turnout, there isn’t any room for error.
We’re focused on turning out every single registered voter, registering new voters, and persuading _**tens of thousands**_ of undecided voters. I’ll be honest: This is very difficult work, but losing simply is not an option this year.
**But trust me, we can do this if we do it together.**
****[So, with just one day to go before our final end-of-month deadline before Election Day, would you donate to make sure we can get our message across to every voter in Pennsylvania?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53695320/376160649/-586780698?refcode=email_103022_eomclose_allactives&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=d66da472-9c58-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjZkYTQ3Mi05YzU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m37BbQjX3OSGOzqBfYYdbhHPG-EIQpRSjsFGDKcOG1U=)****

Hi, Peter, it's John, Trudy's husband (aka the luckiest man in the world). I want to take a moment today to tell you about the first time I met Trudy. This story is really special to me – honestly, I'm already getting choked up just writing this email.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53695928/376163400/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk397-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTZhOTFlNC05ZTU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I9tngD40YUTw6iDDyft9z4zmKfKK6zBoZ-dCjIiZKto=)
Both Trudy and I have lost spouses to cancer. The year after my wife died felt impossible for a million reasons – no one tells you just how isolating grief is. When folks asked me how I was doing, more often than not I found myself fibbing. I learned quickly that most people who asked that question weren't equipped to handle the messy but honest answer.
I first met Trudy about a year after my wife died. She'd heard that my wife passed, and like so many other people, she asked how I was doing. But when Trudy asked that question, it felt entirely different. I could tell within minutes of meeting her that she truly cared about how I felt. She didn't want a shallow, empty answer. **Trudy wanted to actually know how I was doing – and she wanted to help me shoulder some of my grief.** We had a nearly instantaneous connection.
I learned during that first meeting just how big Trudy's heart is. And as I got to know her better, I watched her go through life wearing that big, open heart right on her sleeve. **As a parent, a nurse, and now a candidate for Senate, Trudy leads with empathy, warmth, and genuine compassion for everyone she meets.**
On the campaign trail, Trudy doesn't give people a listening ear just for show; she truly sees folks for who they are – and she won't let anyone get away with a shallow answer to a big, important question. Just like she was trained to do as a nurse, Trudy hunts for the symptoms and then works tirelessly to find the right course of treatment. **That's the type of leader that Washington needs right now.**

clean_body: I learned during that first meeting just how big Trudy's heart is. | | | Hi, Peter, it's John, Trudy's husband (aka the luckiest man in the world). I want to take a moment today to tell you about the first time I met Trudy. This story is really special to me – honestly, I'm already getting choked up just writing this email. = Both Trudy and I have lost spouses to cancer. The year after my wife died felt impossible for a million reasons – no one tells you just how isolating grief is. When folks asked me how I was doing, more often than not I found myself fibbing. I learned quickly that most people who asked that question weren't equipped to handle the messy but honest answer. I first met Trudy about a year after my wife died. She'd heard that my wife passed, and like so many other people, she asked how I was doing. But when Trudy asked that question, it felt entirely different. I could tell within minutes of meeting her that she truly cared about how I felt. She didn't want a shallow, empty answer. Trudy wanted to actually know how I was doing – and she wanted to help me shoulder some of my grief. We had a nearly instantaneous connection. I learned during that first meeting just how big Trudy's heart is. And as I got to know her better, I watched her go through life wearing that big, open heart right on her sleeve. As a parent, a nurse, and now a candidate for Senate, Trudy leads with empathy, warmth, and genuine compassion for everyone she meets. On the campaign trail, Trudy doesn't give people a listening ear just for show; she truly sees folks for who they are – and she won't let anyone get away with a shallow answer to a big, important question. Just like she was trained to do as a nurse, Trudy hunts for the symptoms and then works tirelessly to find the right course of treatment. That's the type of leader that Washington needs right now. (TIME SENSITIVE)? ? ? ? ? 3X MATCH ACTIVE: Help us defeat Big Oil this November >> https://links.messages.lcv.
Peter ? this is bad ? really bad. We've just received word that a major right-wing Super PAC has dropped $5 million into the Arizona Senate race, where Senator Mark Kelly is up against venture capital executive Blake Masters.

Mark Kelly is an environmental champion who just helped secure the most significant climate investment in history. Blake Masters is a climate change denier who's backed by white supremacists.

This move follows a poll that puts the race within two points. Masters' political backers see a window to swing this Senate race, and they've jumped on it. What's more: the same Super PAC has spent millions on the Senate race in Georgia for Herschel Walker to defeat Senator Raphael Warnock.

Peter: Bottom line, we need your help. Environmental field operations are still underfunded, and a group of donors has put together an emergency match fund to triple every contribution. We have to move now or we could lose these races.

Your support is needed to secure important wins from climate candidates in November. TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT when you make a gift of any amount ? even $5 makes a difference >>> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/z9e0fbZ0NYH-

We have a goal to knock on 161,875 doors in Arizona, and a total of 1.17 million doors in critical swing states including Nevada, New Hampshire, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin. And we have digital ads running in support of dozens of pro-environmental candidates, which we'll continue leading up to the election.

Study after study shows that speaking with voters through field organizing is the best way to connect with voters about where candidates stand on critical issues ? and get them to turn out on Election Day.

We're scaling up on-the-ground canvassing operations, getting folks to sign commit-to-vote cards, and helping them sign up to vote by mail. And we're encouraging voters to commit to reminding three friends or family members to vote, a tactic called "Vote Tripling."

We're looking for fellow environmentalists like you, Peter, to help us continue our canvassing efforts and get pro-climate candidates elected in November. Can you chip in?

Every single vote counts. Please, pitch in ? ANY amount can really make a difference right now, even if it's just $5. This could be the difference between ensuring an environmental majority or setting us back indefinitely >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/04wrMWN~AyC_

Help defeat Blake Masters and the other Big Oil candidates running this election cycle. Our future depends on it.

Onward,

Pete Maysmith
Senior VP of Campaigns
LCV Victory Fund

clean_body: We have to make every minute count because this election could decide the trajectory of our country for years to come. | | Derek, we are only nine days away from one of the most consequential midterm elections in American history. We have to make every minute count because this election could decide the trajectory of our country for years to come. If we defend the seats we need to hold on to our majority in the House, and we protect --or better yet, expand \-- our majority in the Senate, we can build on our progress. There’s still time for you to have an impact on races across the country: Make your first $7 donation to the DNC before the final end-of-month deadline of this election. Democrats have proven that when the people put our party in charge, we know how to deliver results. From now until November 8, it is up to all of us to build on our momentum, including you, Derek. Ensuring the DNC meets its end-of-month goal is critical to getting Democrats across the finish line, so I’m asking: Thank you for doing what you can to support Democrats, Derek. Last November, the murder of Officer Michael Chandler of Big Stone Gap shook all of Virginia – a painful reminder of the risk law enforcement willingly embrace every day to protect our communities. AG Miyares gathered with law enforcement investigators and prosecutors outside the U.S. District Courthouse in Abingdon to announce that, following the arrest of the accused gunman, authorities began uncovering a widespread drug trafficking organization in Southwest Virginia. A team of local, state, and federal investigators built a case over the last year. The group flooded Southwest Virginia with more than 100 pounds of methamphetamine, heroin, and fentanyl. 19 individuals were charged with felonies for narcotics conspiracy, distribution, and unlawful firearm possession. body:
Can Senator Duckworth and I count on you to step up before time runs out?

body:
Democracy is on the ballot
in Michigan.
And polls open in just
8 days.

Do you have a plan to vote?

Your completed absentee ballot

by 8 p.m. on Election Day.

in person on November 8th
at your polling location!

Whatever you decide, make sure
you have a plan to vote!

Visit Michigan.gov/Vote
for all the information you need.

I'm having trouble sleeping at night, team.
Every day, I hear more and more really smart people say a "red wave" is coming, and that worries me -- because control of the Senate is at stake this year, and these GOP Senate candidates are absolutely **_BONKERS_**.
We've got snake oil salesman Dr. Oz running in Pennsylvania, Silicon Valley corporate lackey J.D. Vance running in Ohio, and anti-democracy wackos running in Nevada and Arizona. All of them are groveling at Trump's feet and hoping that it's enough to overshadow their absolute unfitness for office.
**These jokers would be a disaster in the Senate, but right now it's looking like they all could win -- which would hand the Senate over to Mitch McConnell!**
If that happens, we can kiss any chance of protecting reproductive rights, expanding voting rights, or confirming Supreme Court justices goodbye. At that point, we might as well just call the billionaires' accountants and let them know that massive tax breaks are on the way!
The fact is, team, if we lose the Senate, we're toast. **Yet Democratic donations have slowed to a crawl, and we're WAY behind on our must-hit end-of-month goal. I'm not even talking about getting ahead. Just to keep up, we need to raise $1,000,000 by TOMORROW.**

| Peter, Tomorrow is the final monthly finance deadline of this entire campaign, so you are sure to be receiving a tremendous amount of requests for your money.

Instead of begging and pleading with you to donate, we simply want to explain how our campaign will use your money if you choose to [donate a few dollars](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=10f285709a&e=8a657725d1) →

California’s 47th Congressional District is one of just 5 races that Republicans must win to take back the House from Nancy Pelosi. The Democrat in this district is far-left agitator Katie Porter.

_(By the way, she is one of the top spenders in the entire country — even more wasteful than Pelosi herself.) _

So, as you can tell...the stakes in this race are high. That’s why we’ve built a professional operation to defeat Katie Porter. Our funding for this operation comes from grassroots supporters like you because, unlike Katie Porter’s campaign, we don’t have funds streaming in from millionaires and billionaires around the country.

We are incredibly intentional with every dollar that comes in the door, and with early voting now underway, we are maximizing every dollar we have to turn out Republicans to vote and persuade undecided voters that Scott Baugh is the best choice in this race.

To do that, we are relying heavily on volunteers to ensure dollars are not wasted on high-priced consultants from Washington, D.C., but we do need to spend critical dollars on operations to reach voters via text messaging, social media and on TV.

So, if you can afford to [chip in a few dollars](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=7a05fd8c8f&e=8a657725d1) to help us get out our message, we promise each dollar will be treated with the care and attention that we know it took for you to earn that dollar in the first place.

Thank you for reading this longer message, and for your continued support in this race!

Sincerely,
Baugh Finance Team

During World War II, 120,000 Japanese-Americans were unjustly forced into internment camps -- including my grandparents and parents. Our family still bears the scars of that dark time in our nation’s history.

Today, we see anti-Asian discrimination in different forms. Elderly grandparents, young people, even spa workers have become tragic victims of anti-Asian discrimination.

_I refuse to become blind or complacent to these injustices._

**I’m working to end anti-Asian hatred and discrimination in all its forms.** We can’t ignore the ugly history of anti-Asian racism in our country. We must speak out against injustice and demand protection for ALL marginalized communities.

I just hope you’ll join me...

I’m deeply grateful for every grassroots donor who chips in to help power this movement — because funding our campaign from the grassroots level makes a powerfully important difference.
Over time, a democracy with political campaigns funded by a small number of people who can contribute a lot of money looks very different from a democracy with campaigns funded by a large number of people who chip in a little at a time.
It’s the difference between a government that works great for those at the top and a government that can work for everyone.
With a grassroots-funded movement powering Democrats to victory in this year’s midterms, we can actually ensure the right to vote, and the right to get that vote counted. We can ensure that Roe v. Wade is the law of the land everywhere. We can pass universal child care. We can pass immigration reform.
But we won’t be able to get anything done if the Republicans take control.
[_**So if you’re able to, please make a donation to support my re-election campaign and Warren Democrats by tomorrow’s fundraising deadline. I want to tell you some stories about my dad, and at the end, I hope you’ll consider chipping in at [michaelbennet.com/contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53697783/376170509/102086035?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221030_PM2_V1_S1_VSP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MGZmNjQyMi1hNzU4LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SJb5qNIYp6IAPSfzs0fo1nv_0PduqbKxskxwSKF2rIU=&emci=8346dd93-a658-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=50ff6422-a758-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=1295540) to support him. After he voted to pass the _Inflation Reduction Act_ this summer, I was one of the very first people Dad called. He doesn’t like to use the word “proud” often, but I could tell, on that night, he was proud. He told me _all_ about what that bill would do to fight the climate crisis. He felt it was one of the most important things he could do for our future — not just for me and my sisters, but for every Coloradan growing up today. That’s just how my dad has been as long as I can remember. **He truly, deeply cares about every single kid he represents. He fights for ALL Colorado families the same way he fights for his own.**

When I was little, we spent family weekends on long drives traversing the Rocky Mountains, meeting with constituents. My mom, my two younger sisters, and I viewed Coloradans as my dad’s bosses. It was our job to listen and to fight for them.
Then, one night when I was a little bit older, Dad sat us all down and asked how we’d feel if he ran for president. Anne, Halina, and I didn’t think twice; we were all in. Mom was a bit more cautious, but ultimately she turned to us and said “this feels like something good that we can do for you all and for your generation.”
My dad didn’t win that race, but he did what he felt was right. He built that campaign around the _Child Tax Credit_ — traveling the country talking about how we could cut child poverty. Last year, he did just that and kept nearly 4 million kids nationwide out of poverty. And if he wins re-election, he’ll keep up his fight to make the _Child Tax Credit_ permanent and end child poverty forever.
And that’s why I’m so grateful to have Michael Bennet as my father and Colorado’s senior Senator. He loves his family. He loves Colorado. And he will always do what’s right — no matter how hard.
**So I am asking: Can you please chip in to re-elect my dad and keep him fighting for Colorado?_Tomorrow night is his last monthly fundraising deadline of this race_ , and he needs all of us to hit his goal.**

I want to tell you some stories about my dad, and at the end, I hope you’ll consider chipping in at to support him. After he voted to pass the Inflation Reduction Act this summer, I was one of the very first people Dad called. He doesn’t like to use the word “proud” often, but I could tell, on that night, he was proud. He told me all about what that bill would do to fight the climate crisis. He felt it was one of the most important things he could do for our future — not just for me and my sisters, but for every Coloradan growing up today. That’s just how my dad has been as long as I can remember. He truly, deeply cares about every single kid he represents. He fights for ALL Colorado families the same way he fights for his own. | | = When I was little, we spent family weekends on long drives traversing the Rocky Mountains, meeting with constituents. My mom, my two younger sisters, and I viewed Coloradans as my dad’s bosses. It was our job to listen and to fight for them. Then, one night when I was a little bit older, Dad sat us all down and asked how we’d feel if he ran for president. Anne, Halina, and I didn’t think twice; we were all in. Mom was a bit more cautious, but ultimately she turned to us and said “this feels like something good that we can do for you all and for your generation.” My dad didn’t win that race, but he did what he felt was right. He built that campaign around the Child Tax Credit — traveling the country talking about how we could cut child poverty. Last year, he did just that and kept nearly 4 million kids nationwide out of poverty. And if he wins re-election, he’ll keep up his fight to make the Child Tax Credit permanent and end child poverty forever. And that’s why I’m so grateful to have Michael Bennet as my father and Colorado’s senior Senator. He loves his family. He loves Colorado. And he will always do what’s right — no matter how hard. So I am asking: Can you please chip in to re-elect my dad and keep him fighting for Colorado?Tomorrow night is his last monthly fundraising deadline of this race , and he needs all of us to hit his goal. name: Jeremy Parkin
subject: We actually talk to voters.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We need funds to contact as many voters as possible!
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221030-3549-header&t=1&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p)
🚨Canvassers, grab your totes, your clipboards, your flyers! All hands on deck!! It’s T Minus 9 days until Election Day!!!! We have to... 🚨
**Hold on a sec, sorry. Let’s back up.**
My name is Jeremy and I’m the Field Director for Team AOC. I wanted to take a pause from the insanity leading up to this election and directly connect with you on the matter of our field program. While many politicians rely on petty attack ads and soulless mailers, I’m proud to share that **our campaign relies on something much simpler: on-the-ground contact with real voters.**
[Before I go any further, if you’re able to rush a donation of any amount to our campaign, it would go a long way in making these voter connections over the next 9 days.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221030.Is29jY&refcode=em20221030-3549-P_FND_EGR_ORG&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p) (But if you’re not convinced, keep reading...)
We prioritize real interactions with the residents of NY-14 above any media strategy or string of appearances, and our entire field program is funded through small dollar donations from supporters like you. And oh boy, do we put those donations to good use...
You see, running a field program requires a lot of STUFF. I’m talking: palm cards, pledge-to-vote cards, policy literature and flyers, clipboards, pens, mobilizing email software, texting programs, phone banking dialers, T-shirts, buttons, advanced voter outreach software (that we developed ourselves in 2018!), not to mention – _office rent._ **That’s right. Team AOC pays rent, just like you.**
And our next 9 days are going to be hectic. We’re running teach-ins, marching in parades, getting folks out for early voting, directing voters to the poll sites, working with allied elected officials, partnering with coalitions like Working Families Party, NYPAN, and Our Revolution, and hitting phones, texts, and doors as hard as possible.
Yeah, you guessed it...this all costs $$$ too.
[Not everyone can volunteer their time, but your donations are crucial to keeping our field team robust. Our average donation this month is $16.43. Can you chip in $16.43 today to help us contact as many voters as possible in this final window so we can win by the greatest majority possible?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221030.Is29jY&refcode=em20221030-3549-P_FND_EGR_ORG&t=3&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p)
**[Contribute $16.43](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221030.Is29jY&refcode=em20221030-3549-P_FND_EGR_ORG&t=22&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p)**
We’d of course also love your help on the ground. If you want to volunteer in addition, [**head to our website and sign up now!**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14951?t=23&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p)
Thank you so much for your continued support.
In solidarity,
Jeremy Parkin
Field Director
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20221030?refcode=em20221030-3549-P_FND_EGR_ORG&t=24&refcode2=3549_2526796_suoy_p&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20221030-3549-P_FND_EGR_ORG&t=25&akid=3549%2E2526796%2Esuoy_p)**

Let me remind you why we’re in this fight.
#
Let me give you an honest analysis about where things stand after last night’s big Texas Ethics Commission deadline...

This isn’t a reason to lose hope. But if we’re going to edge out Greg Abbott in these final days of GOTV, we MUST make up the difference as soon as possible. That’s why I’m extending our goal to the end of the month, and emailing you personally right now.
[**I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t absolutely critical. Can you rush your very first donation to Beto’s people-powered campaign for Governor right now? The future of Texas is on the line, and we must defeat Greg Abbott.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221030-2.cCUjZi&refcode=ema20221030-215095&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=215095%2E444211%2ESRbeQp)

We’re standing up to Greg Abbott’s dangerous and extreme abortion ban, which includes no exception for rape or incest.

[**Donate $3 or anything you can spare to ensure we make it to our extended $5.6 million goal by midnight tomorrow. Nick Rathod

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: You can't be trusted..
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760985:JXjDtQGNG:m:1:3368395361:CF7D2658AA8321FAA635BC4703C98D47:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760985:JXjDtQGNG:m:1:3368395361:CF7D2658AA8321FAA635BC4703C98D47:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760985:JXjDtQGNG:m:1:3368395361:CF7D2658AA8321FAA635BC4703C98D47:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61760985:JXjDtQGNG:m:1:3368395361:CF7D2658AA8321FAA635BC4703C98D47:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,

And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. Ours is a legal one. And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law? No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you for dreaming of a better America with me: an America where reproductive rights are protected, voting rights are expanded and gun violence is prevented.

Thank you for believing that a poor Black girl from the South can grow up to run in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.

body:
| Peter, I'm not the type of person to leave things up to chance. As a meteorologist, I had a responsibility to give folks the information they needed to prepare for the day and week ahead. Parents, teachers, businesses – even football coaches depended on our accurate information. If severe weather hit, I knew what I said on TV could be the difference between life and death. As we approach Election Day, I’m not leaving anything to chance in this race either. **Quite honestly, the race for IL-17 is where our democracy hangs.** My opponent has made it clear she’d continue the assault on reproductive rights. And there’s no doubt she’d join Kevin McCarthy and the rest of the far-right in continuing the destruction of our democratic norms. We’re doing everything in our power to meet this moment head on and keep this district blue. That’s why I'm reaching out: **Can you make a donation of $5 to fuel our final Get Out The Vote push in IL-17? Your support right now WILL still make a huge impact for us.** Here's a good link: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q4-2022](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zSJ2-Su0o8Ni7LeDh2MrPPUvpXBRo6wFsFkfdA82RDzA0w4o1SKo5q-R1KQIe8_mAZx7iLnCTiQDdtSDYr924djy4jLEdRFM3ZdrQg1Ti_1YyVTAOFQEz8pCtYQspaowOkmFtp0W9jvyNSfQlNtQmO7SrM9HyW5SIAyuukHt-Kviu_vEjZdn8BfXmm0jLJAKPKq9sT_wKZLeOTR_v3w646psp9erH9TRl9Z9hdCTqdzdnrdcK6bEuihLKKCCufWHUnnhmMSRQMhu6BIM9MNnc86144T_HM7Q2fOVFwwb9HVc0fZ_EoCIeEyZPMBIe8uhNgF_Q-fDJ8dvicb1DFGWhF7GG0MsTVfBfRD1sxfKWNKQ/3qq/hPlv3G7bRIG6uuHw3s2ygQ/h0/jPy9qVxIHLm5PktbozmdUTyT0OW65hVjTsNfWiigpIU) I can't tell you how much it means to me that our campaign is fueled by individual donors who know that we can do better in Washington. | | | **Join us TONIGHT for our virtual GOTV event with BETO!** Find out who you know that has not voted and get them to the polls. **We only have 9 days to elect Beto O'Rourke and all democrats on the ballot. **

**We have enough numbers to WIN the entire state of Texas, IF you all turn out the voters that you know. You should call and text the people you know with voting information- not strangers. Join our statewide relational GOTV program to turn out voters across the state.**

We will show you at this special meeting on tonight, **with special guest Beto O'Rourke** , the most effective way to get voters to the polls. **When: Oct 30, 2022 06:00 PM Central Time (US and Canada)**
1.** Please make sure to download the REACH app. and join the 2 Million Texans campaign before you join the event. You can do so here: **[www.reach.vote/dl](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=deb197dbd1&e=e2c3d5ef2f)
