[https://us02web.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZIsde-trT8iGdb_oPl1ZRFZzLo1gi_kdXtK ](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=50e50583fb&e=e2c3d5ef2f)

3. **We recommend joining the zoom from your laptop. This will allow you to use REACH on your phone during the event. ** **Why are we asking you to do this?
Watch here. **
[https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=F08aFVSiO68](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=f741fbde63&e=e2c3d5ef2f)

**We can not continue to use only traditional get out the vote methods and expect to win. We literally have the power in our hands. Let use it!**

**This project is powered by generous donations from people like you. We can not do it with out you. We only have 10 days to win this election. Please consider a donation to this unprecedented project. It helped us win in Georgia. It can help us win in Texas!**
See you tonight! Lana Hansen
Executive Director

Friday night former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. _**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

I just got done early voting in Snow Hill, and I was proud to cast my ballot today with my family beside me. They mean the world to me.
When I first decided to run for Congress, I turned to my family. My wife, Yuvonka Batts Davis, and I have been married for 20 years. She's a mom of three incredible boys – Ryan, Justin, and Kyler. We have raised them to be respectful, polite, and service-oriented.
While I have served in elected office for nearly 20 years, this lifestyle is all my kids have known, and they have yet to let us down. So many, including our youngest, who lobbied me for pay raises for his teachers, encouraged me to run for Congress.
When I asked my youngest if I should run, he gave me a thumbs-up. He said, "For years, you have worked hard for our part of the state. Why not? You would do great."
My family has called North Carolina home for six generations. I want to ensure my children and their friends can stay here – raise their families, make a decent living, and live long, healthy lives. I’m running because the East is my home, and we need leaders ready to deliver on the critical needs of our rural communities. We must get our fair share!
**[Our team, including my family and many volunteers across NC-01, are working hard to win this critical race. With less than nine days to go in our fight for the future of eastern NC and rural America, we need your support. Friend,

I’ve defended LGBTQ+ rights from the Trump Administration’s attacks, helped the first LGBTQ+ couples in Pennsylvania marry, and pushed to expand legal protections for our Commonwealth’s LGBTQ+ communities. As Governor, I’m committed to finally banning discrimination against LGBTQ+ Pennsylvanians so that they can find jobs, attend school, and seek housing with the equal rights and protections they deserve. **For too long, members of the LGBTQ+ community have not been afforded equal protection under the law. # **ICYMI: Emilia Sykes garners major endorsements from the Akron Beacon Journal and****The Plain Dealer**
#### _"We are confident [Emilia Sykes] will listen to the needs of Akron-Canton constituents if she moves from the Statehouse to Congress and work across the aisle to get things done."_
---
| Akron, OH – In case you missed it, the [Akron Beacon Journal](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=f75850aaec&e=7730fa895a) endorsed Emilia Sykes for the 13th Congressional District.

"_Sykes has been accessible and spoken about issues that matter to the 13th District, which includes all of Summit County, northwestern Stark County and a sliver of Portage County._ ” writes the **Akron Beacon Journal Editorial Board**. "_If elected, Sykes said she is determined to build relationships with Republicans — even if she were to find herself in the minority — so that she can make government work for her constituents_."

The editorial goes on to contrast Sykes' long history of listening to constituents and working across the aisle to fight for health care access, public safety and to protect our democracy with Madison Gesiotto Gilbert’s extremism and refusal to speak directly to voters:

"_[I]n this case, we really must call out Gesiotto Gilbert. She is a Trump extremist who is eager to disparage Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi, but has nothing specific to say about the 13th District...Gesiotto Gilbert has been largely absent from the campaign trail, rarely allowed herself to be interviewed by journalists and never took part in a true public forum with media coverage_."

You can read the full endorsement from the Akron Beacon-Journal editorial board [HERE](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=9edf308335&e=7730fa895a).

This comes on the heels of an endorsement from [Cleveland.com/The Plain Dealer](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=2bef37e6d6&e=7730fa895a) editorial board, as well. “ _Voters in Ohio’s 13th Congressional District should send Emilia Sykes to Congress. Early voting in the Nov. 8 election has begun_ ,” writes the editorial board. ### **About Emilia Sykes**
Emilia Sykes is the State Representative for Ohio’s 34th legislative district. Born in Akron and raised on the city’s west side, Emilia has worked tirelessly to keep jobs in our state and expand opportunity for working families in Northeast Ohio. As House Minority Leader she worked with Republicans and Democrats to deliver real results for Ohio’s families, businesses, and seniors.

Emilia will bring a fresh perspective to Washington, and fight for opportunity for every child, senior, and family in Northeast Ohio, regardless of their politics or beliefs.

Learn more about Emilia Sykes at [www.EmiliaSykesforCongress.com](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=c84a586fb5&e=7730fa895a). Follow along for updates @[EmiliaSykesOH](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=be8c6a5ae1&e=7730fa895a) on Twitter and on Facebook at [Facebook.com/E](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=0406c30835&e=7730fa895a)[miliaSykes](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=7684270ed9&e=7730fa895a).

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

#
Derek, $31.63 is our average contribution for October.
**Here’s why we’re proud of that number:** Our average contribution proves that this movement is powered by small-dollar donations.
This campaign isn’t funded by corporate PACs or a career scamming people out of their hard-earned money _(ahem, like Dr. Oz)_. We’ve relied on real people like you donating what + when they’re able to since Day One — and we plan to keep it that way.
**[So we’re asking one more time ahead of our last end-of-month fundraising deadline before the election: Will you make a contribution of our average $31.63 or any amount you’re able to today?** **[Donate $31.63 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221030-3?amount=31.63&refcode=em20221030-7969&refcode2=7969_434096_BqXAlK&akid=7969%2E434096%2EBqXAlK)** John understands what is at stake if we don’t flip this seat. While Oz might be wasting his time + money running for Senate in a state he doesn't even live in, John knows that real, everyday working people stand to lose so much if Oz wins. That’s why with every contribution of $31.63 — or whatever folks are able to contribute — we’re building a powerful movement of folks across Pennsylvania and the country who are ready to fight for our future. Every donation adds up and helps fund our plans to mobilize as many voters in the Commonwealth as possible so we can finally make real progress on the issues that impact us the most. **[Will you help us reach our end-of-month goal by making a contribution of our average amount ($31.63) or any amount today? subject: Using kids to drum up fear
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221030&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221030&amount=28]
Team,
We emailed you earlier this week about Elissa’s opponent's out-of-touch views on personal freedom, specifically on choice and gay marriage. He strongly opposes both, describing himself as “100% pro-life – no exceptions.” And in a live debate, he made it clear he is deeply opposed to gay marriage -- he even voted to ban it outright in Michigan.
Last week, a mailer claiming that Michigan’s ballot proposal 3 would allow child sterilization without parental consent — a claim that has been fact-checked and found false by Michigan media [https://www.clickondetroit.com/news/politics/2022/10/26/fact-check-michigan-prop-3-would-not-allow-child-sterilization-without-parental-consent/] — was circulated in MI07. The ballot proposal would actually codify the Roe standard and ensure protections for contraception, IVF, and pre- and post- natal care.
https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/politics/michigan/2022/10/25/slotkin-pans-gop-mailer-on-parental-consent-as-false/69589083007/ [https://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/politics/michigan/2022/10/25/slotkin-pans-gop-mailer-on-parental-consent-as-false/69589083007/] https://thelivingstonpost.com/state-gop-mailing-pairs-barrett-with-community-extremist-stokes-fear-over-lgbtq-kids/ [https://thelivingstonpost.com/state-gop-mailing-pairs-barrett-with-community-extremist-stokes-fear-over-lgbtq-kids/]
We’ve included a photo of the mailer, so you can see what this stuff actually looks like:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87595/images/Ff8UR1vWYAAzgcZ.jpeg][https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87595/images/Ff8UR1tXwAEnuWU.jpeg]
It seems Elissa’s opponent is ending his campaign the same way it started: drumming up fear and hate and using children as political pawns. As a reminder, this spring he sent out a fundraising text prompting recipients to click a link to cancel their child’s “gender reassignment surgery.” The link was, of course, actually his fundraising page.
It’s clear Elissa’s opponent isn’t focusing on the issues Michiganders are talking about when it comes to our kids: playing catch-up from COVID, ensuring school safety, and making mental health resources more readily available. Amazingly, he’s never voted to approve a single dollar for Michigan schools – voting as an extreme outlier against every bipartisan K-12 bill that has come before him in his eight years as a politician.
Elissa’s opponent would rather sow division and fan the flames of the culture wars than support the families he represents. The worst part? This race is going to come down to the wire. We’re working day and night to ensure his extreme views don’t make it to Congress, where there is a very real chance he will be voting on bills pertaining to choice, gay marriage, and the safety of our kids. Chip in to help us keep Elissa’s opponent’s extremism out of Congress. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221030&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221030&amount=28]

body:
You may remember me as a former (fictional) president, but I’m reaching out to you today about a real leader who we have the chance to elect on November 8th: Cheri Beasley.
#

Hi there, Martin Sheen here.
You may remember me as a former (fictional) president, but I’m reaching out to you today about a real leader who we have the chance to elect on November 8th: Cheri Beasley.
She is the kind of leader that we tried to portray in The West Wing’s best moments. Hers is a story that took her from public defender to the first African American woman to serve as Chief Justice of North Carolina. Just like the characters we portrayed on television, she is inspiring, hardworking, and dedicated to serving people and getting results and justice for all.
But unlike The West Wing, there is no writers’ room that can control the outcome of an election. That’s up to each and every one of us. It’s our job to put in the work to secure our democracy by electing a leader like Cheri Beasley.
[**So I am sincerely asking you to join me in supporting Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate today. Your donation today could make all the difference when the votes are counted.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221030-3-T1&t=1&akid=2175%2E357359%2EpnAHDR)
**[DONATE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221030-3-T1&refcode2=2175.357359.pnAHDR&t=2&akid=2175%2E357359%2EpnAHDR)**
When West Wing plotlines got heated and dramatic, they typically came to tidy and easy resolutions at the end of an episode or season.
In real life, it’s much more complicated.
We are at a critical juncture in the history of our democracy, and we must ask ourselves: What story do we want to tell about America?
Do we want to be a democracy where not everyone’s voice is equally heard at the ballot box? A country where rising health care and prescription drug costs mean larger profits for Big Pharma while our loved ones put off lifesaving treatments or ration medications? Will we be a country where truth is thwarted by lies and conspiracies that put the interests of extreme politicians above all else?
Absolutely not, and I refuse to sit on the sidelines. This is a country where we can elect North Carolina’s first Black Senator and where she can cast the decisive 51st vote to protect our democracy, our rights and our freedoms. We must do everything we can to fight for the vision of a more equal America that we all aspire for.
[**So please, stand with me and stand with Cheri in this fight by making a $3 donation to her campaign today. Together, I know we can do great things.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221030-3-T1&t=3&akid=2175%2E357359%2EpnAHDR)

body:
Mark needs your help — even if he can’t ask you directly or in person.
#

Friends —
We all know winning the most competitive U.S. Senate race in the country won’t be easy. There’s a lot of travel, events, time spent on the phone and on video calls — time away from your family.
You have to face millions and millions of dollars in ads attacking you personally.
You have to watch the former president hold multiple rallies in your state where he goes on extended rants about you, trying to convince his supporters you are a terrible person.
And you have to hope that hundreds of thousands of people you might never meet will join you, rallying behind you to help you fight back.
All for a race that will probably come down to a few thousand votes.
But that’s exactly why every single one of those donations matters. Because this is one of the closest races in the country. And Mark does need your help — even if he can’t ask you directly or in person.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4d9ceee5a8b54e3484bc6b7214b27f38&_e=4x0Js7T1Yq8iprHfWotnfHUeEY-LK3h_KBX7Dvre22QZeOprKMgFyQ8rgkPzPshAQMhE8iJr6Gb1yvBtRt4N1Y5qP5yfB5wb0-qCX-Zj8rmDka0kVp9eFGrEU_as5PL5bnj64NrRe1pgTtwtocdcuZsA-i7bxTkrXLvn31JM_jKBT1MWVvMPz1LBufHLasEAcP6YxpCTZFaEPEkJS8PlMNWKjcyWzi-InsaoJsWapTIa5Bc3ja1-vA0d0K0pB--NacMol8Yu4mMLsd45nPXw-MlNSRT1msng1bcbpUi_BKQfkFaU-o6nNBIDhltKzkGzXcdascy494yrszzwcVrYZoczxAC1vb_baW93pVn9LY2Ode_ODh6pLP3xw8xx0X_5RLqqApvmsdXJ82WTVy7KZg%3D%3D)

Peter,

Friday night former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4d9ceee5a8b54e3484bc6b7214b27f38&_e=4x0Js7T1Yq8iprHfWotnfHUeEY-LK3h_KBX7Dvre22QZeOprKMgFyQ8rgkPzPshAQMhE8iJr6Gb1yvBtRt4N1Y5qP5yfB5wb0-qCX-Zj8rmDka0kVp9eFGrEU_as5PL5bnj64NrRe1pgTtwtocdcuZsA-i7bxTkrXLvn31JM_jKBT1MWVvMPz1LBufHLasEAcP6YxpCTZFaEPEkJS8PlMNWKjcyWzi-InsaoJsWapTIa5Bc3ja1-vA0d0K0pB--N3YZh8QVCZIsfvk2ExFBk0RSh9k2ualEPgxy0oKJc-iy5s7tI_nJJyfUZtUTwQsTVmFxx3si1T71fPODUPLgeVOOGAgCX1QjqB1zEMvn7D2GWqZAjNzxtUqU9m3mFU-x5z2tcbULc75GdEEnWilFGpA%3D%3D)
Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4d9ceee5a8b54e3484bc6b7214b27f38&_e=4x0Js7T1Yq8iprHfWotnfHUeEY-LK3h_KBX7Dvre22QZeOprKMgFyQ8rgkPzPshAQMhE8iJr6Gb1yvBtRt4N1Y5qP5yfB5wb0-qCX-Zj8rmDka0kVp9eFGrEU_as5PL5bnj64NrRe1pgTtwtocdcuZsA-i7bxTkrXLvn31JM_jKBT1MWVvMPz1LBufHLasEAcP6YxpCTZFaEPEkJS8PlMNWKjcyWzi-InsaoJsWapTIa5Bc3ja1-vA0d0K0pB--NQdRzLbkCLzFAr3tNXpL0jzcrItz4auZBg7fBsZ25nLDF6RBuF9uBs773EriTtyZs_lhQji2Irmgs22-g5nGb1n3lbYap8MVNnNrKSWqaxv3EjOpceTkxg7ga0Gyam8RuQDqXJ7vqz4nvHBnWxUdidw%3D%3D)
They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. **That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia.**

_**What did President Obama have to say about me?**_ He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; _I'm a warrior for God._

He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom.

**With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out.**

But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4d9ceee5a8b54e3484bc6b7214b27f38&_e=4x0Js7T1Yq8iprHfWotnfHUeEY-LK3h_KBX7Dvre22QZeOprKMgFyQ8rgkPzPshAQMhE8iJr6Gb1yvBtRt4N1Y5qP5yfB5wb0-qCX-Zj8rmDka0kVp9eFGrEU_as5PL5bnj64NrRe1pgTtwtocdcuZsA-i7bxTkrXLvn31JM_jKBT1MWVvMPz1LBufHLasEAcP6YxpCTZFaEPEkJS8PlMNWKjcyWzi-InsaoJsWapTIa5Bc3ja1-vA0d0K0pB--N_Adcdsu0t_d3JKzRUDon3jbieLCK9KmV3NhuIsFHI2xAdYe69JnBtlVuqbihTn-heIt9gRMls_iHJkPfNwv2Z7pMzcap5llUlqGhHnKngKb7K0DFhR5BrqHvxNkI0D4CRnhN0q1BHTK9dFeFnBeq8Q%3D%3D)
**[I need your help. We're being outraised by millions, and the gap is growing with President Obama's visit. clean_body: With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out | Peter, Friday night former President Obama was in Atlanta to campaign for Raphael Warnock and Stacey Abrams. Democrats know that Georgia is KEY to the Senate majority, so they are using all their big names to make a last-minute pitch for the struggling campaigns of Warnock and Abrams. They saw how Senator Warnock performed at our debate. They can't believe after spending $60 million to attack me, this race is still tied. And we know they're desperate because we heard it directly from Chuck Schumer and Joe Biden this week during their hot mic moment. That's why Democrats sounded the alarm and asked President Obama to campaign in Georgia. What did President Obama have to say about me? He called me a celebrity who wants to be a politician. He got that one wrong. I'm not a celebrity or your typical politician; I'm a warrior for God. He got something else wrong, too. He encouraged us to vote for Joe Biden two years ago, didn't he? We've all seen how that's worked out for us - record inflation, open borders, more crime, and less freedom. With his poor track record of losing Georgia twice and encouraging us to support Joe Biden, I think President Obama probably needs to sit this one out. But here's the thing, Peter. President Obama's visit to Georgia will gin up Democrats and help Senator Warnock raise millions. The moment he got off the stage, my opponent was begging supporters for money. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker, Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Kentucky
against Rand Paul.

I just saw some flyers that my opponent is sending out about me -- and
they are disgusting. Full of lies as usual, folks. (Even though I’m
reluctant to give them free advertising, I thought you should see how
ridiculous these are):

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18810?t=1001&akid=2691%2E346206%2Ezue4N7 ][IMG]

It’s a clear sign that Rand Paul is fully aware of the momentum we're
